method: Offline exact-marker scan of the supplied captured JavaScript and CSS; generic public package/runtime signatures only. This is not a package-lock inventory, dependency install record or runtime execution trace.
privacy: Library names, fixed public marker families and aggregate counts only. Captured source, private identifiers, URLs, class/element text, asset paths and copied third-party code are excluded.

technologies.name: React
technologies.evidence: React runtime element/fragment/portal markers in multiple bundles, and React DOM references.
technologies.note: Runtime markers support identification; the exact build/version and executed route were not recovered.

technologies.name: React Router
technologies.evidence: React Router package references, router context and RouterProvider identifiers.
technologies.role: Client routing and route data conventions
technologies.note: Router code is present. Specific routes and loader execution were not traced.

technologies.name: Tailwind CSS
technologies.evidence: Tailwind custom-property prefix, utility layer and framework references in saved stylesheets.
technologies.note: Static generated CSS is present; no complete Tailwind build configuration was captured.

technologies.name: Radix UI
technologies.evidence: Radix-specific attributes and library identifiers in both JavaScript and CSS.
technologies.role: Menu, popup or interactive primitive candidates
technologies.note: Package markers do not establish the exact source component or live interaction.

technologies.name: ProseMirror
technologies.evidence: ProseMirror-specific runtime and stylesheet markers across multiple saved files.
technologies.note: Presence does not establish which captured textbox used it or its plugin inventory.

technologies.name: KaTeX
technologies.evidence: KaTeX stylesheet/JavaScript markers and a captured math font corpus.
technologies.note: Math renderer assets are present; individual rendered expressions were not analyzed.

technologies.name: Floating UI
technologies.evidence: Exact Floating UI naming in two saved JavaScript files.
technologies.note: Marker evidence does not independently establish use in the captured dialog.

technologies.name: TanStack Query
technologies.evidence: QueryClientProvider signature present in saved JavaScript; generic queryKey names alone are insufficient.
technologies.role: Potential client query caching and synchronization
technologies.note: Do not infer concrete queries or cache contents from this signature.

technologies.name: React Markdown / micromark
technologies.evidence: React Markdown naming in one JavaScript file and micromark naming in two.
technologies.note: The markers do not prove a precise package/version combination or which view uses it.

technologies.name: Motion / Framer Motion family
technologies.evidence: Motion-value and visual-element implementation signatures in saved JavaScript.
technologies.note: No version or runtime animation was verified.

technologies.name: highlight.js-style classes
technologies.evidence: hljs-prefixed class references appear in saved CSS and JavaScript.
technologies.note: Class naming alone does not prove highlight.js was the active engine.

unresolved.reason: singleFetch and React Router markers occur, but a full Remix framework installation/runtime was not verified.
The inspected markers did not establish a Next.js runtime; this is not proof of absence.
Generic state-store signatures cannot uniquely identify application state management packages.
The ZIP did not establish a trustworthy version for the named packages.

page_map.method: Structural and whitelisted-control classification of one saved rendered DOM. Nested region counts overlap; none of the labels below are copied page text.

nodes.description: A large side region contains two navigation subtrees.

nodes.title: Primary navigation
nodes.description: First navigation region inside the sidebar.

nodes.title: Secondary navigation

nodes.description: Main region containing the page header and the composer form.

nodes.title: Composer form
nodes.description: One form with three buttons and four file inputs. A textbox role is present elsewhere in the captured document; direct ownership is not asserted.

page_map.note: Control-category figures count matching aria-label attribute text (including duplicates); they are not unique features, distinct active controls or UI states.
